That done, travel south. And then, venture east. And then, attempt to venture north. Then, make an effort to take a trip north. And then, attempt to move north. Next, attempt to take a trip north. With that done, go west. With that accomplished, try to take a trip south. And then, take a trip east. That done, make an attempt to take a trip north. Next, go to the north. Then, make an effort to venture north. With that done, make an effort to venture west. Following that, venture north. With that over with, take a trip east. If you can finish that, go to the east. Then, attempt to travel south. And then, make an attempt to venture south. And then, go to the south. Next, go east. With that done, go to the south. And then, try to travel west. If you can accomplish that, move south. And then, venture south. Next, go south. Okay, and then, make an effort to go west. Once you get around to doing that, make an effort to go north. Then, make an attempt to venture west. Following that, make an attempt to travel north. After that, head east. After that, go east. With that done, make an effort to travel south. Once you get through with that, attempt to travel east. Once you get around to doing that, move south. With that accomplished, move west. Then, attempt to head south. With that done, make an attempt to move east. If you can manage that, head north. And then, attempt to move north. Then, make an attempt to venture west. Once you get through with that, venture west. After that, venture north. Following that, head north. Then, take a trip east. Then, make an attempt to take a trip south. After that, attempt to go to the west. And then, attempt to go north. Then, try to take a trip north. With that accomplished, try to go to the east. And then, venture east. After that, take a trip east. Following that, move south. After that, go east. And then, attempt to move east. And then, try to travel east. Then, take a trip north. Then, try to head north. After that, venture west. After that, head south. And then, travel south. And then, make an effort to travel east. Then, go to the east. And then, go south. And then, attempt to travel west. And then, make an attempt to head south. Then, try to head west. That done, try to head south. And then, go to the east. With that done, make an effort to go east. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. With that over with, take a trip west. And then, move north. That done, take a trip west. With that done, make an attempt to travel north. With that done, head west. Then, try to go to the west. With that accomplished, make an effort to take a trip north. Then, make an attempt to go to the west. With that accomplished, try to take a trip south. Then, attempt to go to the east. Then, make an attempt to go to the north. Then, travel north. Then, attempt to head west. That done, make an attempt to take a trip west. After that, go south. After that, make an effort to travel south. That done, head east. And then, lift the coin from the floor of the spotless laundromat. Alright, thanks!
